ops.title: vcs: stack submit pushes the clean downstack prefix when a child fails to restack
ops.description: Seen on the rv-spend-ddog lane, 2026-09-25: submit refuses to push a clean parent when only its child fails to restack. Proposal: submit the downstack prefix that restacked cleanly and name the child that did not, with its conflict.

ops.text: A stack whose child conflicts on restack submits the parent and reports the child with its conflict
Branches above the failed child are left unmoved and unsubmitted
